314-ritu-setup.text: Two overs done, zero runs on the board. Topley taking the ball to bowl to Rohit now.

315-sunny-chatter.text: Another dot. The collapse process has officially commenced, guys.

316-ritu-chatter.text: Hey, four leg-byes count on the scoreboard just the same. We take those.

317-dev-chatter.text: No problem at all, bhai! Rohit is just taking his time to settle down.

318-ritu-tease.text: Ten balls, zero runs, and trapped right in front. Brilliant start for your captain, bro.

318-dev-tease.text: Bhai, you said Rohit was playing the long game today! What happened?

318-sunny-nudge_away.text: Go make a chai, you, Rohit just walked back and we will call you when anything actually happens.

362-ritu-setup.text: Ten overs gone, score is twenty eight for two, and Carse is running in to Kohli.

363-sunny-chatter.text: Just a single, taking it slow as usual.

364-ritu-lament.text: Zero on the board, this is just painful.

364-sunny-tease.text: Ritu, your hero really showed us how not to bat today.

365-ritu-chatter.text: Another single added, need to build something here.

366-dev-chatter.text: Solid defense from the king, bhai, just wearing them down before the storm.

367-ritu-chatter.text: Taking singles now, but someone needs to wake up the scoreboard soon.

368-sunny-chatter.text: Another dot. We are sleepwalking right into a trap.

369-dev-callback.text: Get back here right now, you, Kohli is facing Willey and things are moving.

370-dev-lament.text: No way, how did that happen, the king is gone and my heart is broken, bhai.

370-ritu-tease.text: Dev, your king is back in the hut already, time to start the usual panic.

532-sunny-lament.text: There goes our anchor. Three runs off thirteen. Exactly as I expected.

532-dev-tease.text: Sunny bhai, your main man gave us a proper masterclass in batting today, absolute legend.

534-dev-setup.text: Last pair in, brothers. One forty-six for nine, and Topley is running in to Prasidh.

536-dev-final.text: Well fought, bhai, we fell short today, but we will bounce back stronger next time.

536-sunny-final.text: Told you all from the very first over. Nothing surprising here at all.

369-ritu-chatter.text: Another dot ball, bro. At this rate we are going to need a time machine.

535-sunny-chatter.text: Just one wicket left. The inevitable is finally arriving.

R1-318-me|comeback: Relax Ritu, even a double-hundred machine gets a good ball early on.
At least Rohit took ten balls to get out, Ritu, unlike your wild predictions!
Save the sarcasm Ritu, we still have a long chase ahead of us.
R1-364-ritu|tease: Ritu, is that fearless batting or just giving free catches to Carse?
Five balls, zero runs! Where are all those outrageous Pant shots now, Ritu?
Keep keeping receipts on my bad predictions, Ritu, while Pant leaves for a duck!
R1-370-dev|tease: Dev, your run machine with forty ODI tons just walked off for sixteen!
Is chasing still Kohli's favorite sport, Dev, or should we ask Willey?
Dev bhai, your eternal optimism is getting tested real hard after that sixteen.
R1-532-sunny|tease: Sunny, even your chess-playing hero Chahal couldn't trick the bowler with three runs.
That masterclass of three runs from Chahal really saved the innings, didn't it, Sunny?
Chahal tried his best chess move and got bowled for three, right Sunny?
